resolutions.rationale: The closing identifies historical manuscript Bibles as the referent, but the evidence establishes specific altered attributions and manuscript variation rather than the exact defect of every Bible; the universal formulation therefore materially outruns the demonstrated scope.

The pro side's debate-wide strengths and limits on altered attribution, early recovery, and historical Bibles are already represented by the disputed-sayings, bottleneck, and historical-Bibles moves, leaving no distinct unscored consequence.

The con side's debate-wide case for collective preservation, convergence, and denial of misquotation is already represented by the tenacity, one-text-emerges, and final-motion moves, leaving no distinct unscored consequence.
